messages.subject: Multi session addTelemetry() error
parts:
I am having trouble combining a multisession live-trapping capture history with concurrent  multisession telemetry data. Creating both the live-capture history and telemetry capture history work fine.  I run into problems when I try to combine them using the addTelemetry() function and get the following:

 

 

 

captures<-read.csv("_IP_CaptureData_2018_6.27.2018_individualsessions1-2_fix2019.7.16.csv")

 

opcaptures<- captures[ which(captures$Species=='Opossum'), ]

traps<-read.traps(file= c("trapsession.1.txt","trapsession.2.txt","trapsession.3.txt","trapsession.4.txt","trapsession.5.txt","trapsession.6.txt","trapsession.7.txt","trapsession.8.txt","trapsession.9.txt","trapsession.10.txt","trapsession.11.txt","trapsession.12.txt","trapsession.13.txt","trapsession.14.txt","trapsession.15.txt","trapsession.16.txt","trapsession.17.txt","trapsession.18.txt","trapsession.19.txt","trapsession.20.txt","trapsession.21.txt","trapsession.22.txt","trapsession.23.txt","trapsession.24.txt","trapsession.25.txt","trapsession.26.txt","trapsession.27.txt","trapsession.28.txt","trapsession.29.txt","trapsession.30.txt","trapsession.31.txt","trapsession.32.txt","trapsession.33.txt","trapsession.34.txt","trapsession.35.txt","trapsession.36.txt","trapsession.37.txt","trapsession.38.txt","trapsession.39.txt","trapsession.40.txt","trapsession.41.txt","trapsession.42.txt","trapsession.43.txt","trapsession.44.txt","trapsession.45.txt","trapsession.46.txt","trapsession.47.txt","trapsession.48.txt"),

messages.subject: Re: Multi session addTelemetry() error
parts:
David
Thanks for sending your data. It seems quite problematic: 48 trapping sessions with no animals caught in many sessions and almost no recaptures; telemetry data were only available for some of the sessions. This immediately causes a problem for addTelemetry, which expects matching detection and telemetry sessions in multi-session data. I guess addTelemetry could be modified for telemetry in only a subset of sessions. I'll  look at that, but this dataset is not very motivating.
Murray
